method.memory: Runtime.getHeapUsage is the page renderer V8 isolate, including extension isolated worlds; it is not total extension or browser memory.
method.gc: Each scenario records natural heap followed by three forced-GC measurements and their median.
method.process: Windows owned browser process tree only. workingSetSumBytes double-counts shared pages; privateCommittedSumBytes is committed private memory, not resident memory. These noisy whole-browser totals are supplementary.
method.network: Only owned localhost fixture allowed. No API key or translation requests.
method.worker: Service-worker heaps are measured separately with debugger attachment and must not be added as persistent residency.
method.retainedCode: Closing reading releases the surface; already loaded modules/code may remain cached. Repeated cycles assess retained live objects.
method.pdf: PDF scenarios sample the reader UI renderer V8 isolate only. The PDF.js dedicated worker isolate, native image buffers, canvas and GPU memory are not included in that heap figure.
